beats.say: William Contreras is the seventh catcher to win the World Series MVP.
He started his career with a $10,000 signing bonus in 2015.
That low cost made his MVP win a huge return for the team.
His brother Willson also won a World Series, a rare sibling feat.
Few catchers reach this level, making his success truly special.
That was Sport Shocks, subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
Who is your favourite catcher in baseball history?
